passages.text: At the back of our family shop stands a small wooden cupboard. A label says that it was made more than a century ago. Grandfather already cleaned it, but one of its doors is still stuck. He asks me to hold a lamp while he checks the lock. Inside, we find old photographs and a notebook full of family names. We do not throw anything away because the objects tell our family story. By evening, the cupboard is open and everyone has something new to ask.

parallelText.en: At the back of our family shop stands a small wooden cupboard.
parallelText.zh: 我们家商店后面有一个小木柜。

parallelText.en: A label says that it was made more than a century ago.
parallelText.zh: 标签上写着，它是一百多年前制作的。

parallelText.en: Grandfather already cleaned it, but one of its doors is still stuck.
parallelText.zh: 祖父已经把它清洁过了，但一扇柜门仍卡着。

parallelText.en: He asks me to hold a lamp while he checks the lock.
parallelText.zh: 他检查锁时，让我帮忙举着灯。

parallelText.en: Inside, we find old photographs and a notebook full of family names.
parallelText.zh: 柜子里有旧照片，还有一本写满家人姓名的笔记本。

parallelText.en: We do not throw anything away because the objects tell our family story.
parallelText.zh: 我们什么也没扔，因为这些物品讲述着家族故事。

parallelText.en: By evening, the cupboard is open and everyone has something new to ask.
parallelText.zh: 到了傍晚，柜子打开了，每个人都有了想问的新问题。

wordHelp.meaning: a piece of furniture with doors for keeping things
a small piece of paper giving information
unable to move
a device that keeps a door closed

passages.text: Ravi borrows a book about the universe from the small village library. He wants to tell his younger sister about the stars in its pictures. At first, several pages are too difficult for him to understand. Instead of returning the book, he writes questions and visits the librarian. His determination helps him keep learning a little after school each day. A week later, he can explain one picture in his own words. His sister listens carefully, then asks to borrow the book with him.

parallelText.en: Ravi borrows a book about the universe from the small village library.
parallelText.zh: 拉维从村里的小图书馆借了一本关于宇宙的书。

parallelText.en: He wants to tell his younger sister about the stars in its pictures.
parallelText.zh: 他想向妹妹讲讲书中图片里的星星。

parallelText.en: At first, several pages are too difficult for him to understand.
parallelText.zh: 起初，有几页对他来说太难理解了。

parallelText.en: Instead of returning the book, he writes questions and visits the librarian.
parallelText.zh: 他没有把书还掉，而是记下问题，去请教图书管理员。

parallelText.en: His determination helps him keep learning a little after school each day.
parallelText.zh: 他的决心帮助他每天放学后坚持学一点。

parallelText.en: A week later, he can explain one picture in his own words.
parallelText.zh: 一周后，他能用自己的话解释其中一张图片。

parallelText.en: His sister listens carefully, then asks to borrow the book with him.
parallelText.zh: 妹妹认真听，然后提出和他一起借这本书。
